description: 确定性日历与工作日计算（1900–2100，内置 2025–2027 中国法定节假日与调休补班）/ Deterministic date & China workday calculator (2025-2027 official holidays). action is auto-inferred when omitted. Examples: diff={"startDate":"2026-01-01","endDate":"2026-12-31"}; offset={"baseDate":"2026-09-28","delta":5,"unit":"workdays"}; inspect={"date":"2027-02-06"}.

action.description: 可选操作类型（省略时自动推断）/ Optional action: diff | offset | inspect

delta.description: 【offset】加减整数（负数倒推，范围 -36500..36500）/ Integer offset, e.g. 5 or -10

includeEnd.description: 【diff】是否含结束日（默认 true）/ Include end date (default true)

unit.description: 【offset】偏移单位 / Unit: workdays (default) | days | weeks | months | years

workdayRule.description: 工作日规则 / Workday rule: cn_official (China holidays, default) | standard (Mon-Fri)

name: calculate_date
title: 日期与工作日计算（妙用盒）
